nodes.label: Celery beat (single instance)
nodes.rationale: In k8s run beat as exactly one pod, otherwise each worker fires every periodic job; use beat not APScheduler (runs in every Flask replica).

nodes.label: Task writing rules (JSON args, idempotent)
nodes.rationale: Pass ids not ORM objects; tasks may run twice after retry so must be idempotent.

nodes.label: Function access algorithm (AND rule)
nodes.rationale: User must hold all permissions required by a function; function with none is denied; adding a permission narrows access.

nodes.label: Keycloak-only authentication (JWKS token verification)
nodes.rationale: Users identified by token sub, never by email, since email can change.
